prompt: Order the steps for producing a weekly client status report with AI help.

task.prompt: Order the steps for producing a weekly client status report with AI help.

items.label: Gather the facts: progress, risks, decisions needed
Remove data the tool does not need, such as personal or secret details
Ask the AI to draft the update from those facts only
Check every claim and set the RAG status yourself

task.explanation: Facts in, minimal data, draft, human verification and judgement, then the PM owns it.

prompt: An AI draft of your status report sounds very positive, but you know the project is a week behind.

task.prompt: An AI draft of your status report sounds very positive, but you know the project is a week behind.

steps.question: What do you do?
options: Rewrite the status to state the delay, its cause and the plan
Send it as is; the client likes good news
Ask the AI for a different tone and send whatever comes back
Delay the report until you catch up
steps.explanation: The PM owns the message; honest status protects trust.

steps.question: How can you avoid this next time?
options: Give the AI the actual RAG status and risks as input, and ask it not to add assessments
Let the AI decide the RAG status
steps.explanation: Better inputs and clear instructions reduce misleading drafts; judgement stays with you.

prompt: A PM's prompt to draft a status report. Mark the problems.

task.prompt: A PM's prompt to draft a status report. Mark the problems.

segments.text: Write a weekly status update for a non-technical client sponsor.
Use only the facts below; do not add forecasts or numbers that are not listed.
Also include the database password so they can check the data.
segments.issue: Never put secrets in prompts or reports.

segments.text: Make the status green regardless of the risks.
segments.issue: Asks the AI to mislead the client.

segments.text: Keep it to 150 words with a clear ask at the end.

prompt: Review the AI draft in the context against the facts, then write the corrected status update you would send. Keep it short.

task.prompt: Review the AI draft in the context against the facts, then write the corrected status update you would send. Keep it short.
task.context:
Facts: Sprint 6 of 8. 21 of 26 stories done. Risk: App Store review may take longer than planned because of a new privacy-label requirement. Decision needed: client to approve the privacy-label wording by Wednesday. Demo Friday.

AI draft: "Great week! The project is green and will launch early. All stories are nearly done and App Store approval is guaranteed. No action needed from you."

rubric.label: Accurate facts
rubric.description: States progress (21 of 26 stories, sprint 6 of 8) and the demo correctly.

rubric.label: Risk stated honestly
rubric.description: Includes the App Store review risk and removes the false guarantee and early-launch claim.

rubric.label: Clear ask
rubric.description: Asks the client to approve the privacy-label wording by Wednesday.

rubric.label: Appropriate tone
rubric.description: Plain, factual and suitable for a sponsor; no hype.

task.sampleAnswer:
Status: amber

Progress: Sprint 6 of 8. 21 of 26 stories are done. Demo on Friday.

Risk: App Store review may take longer than planned because of a new privacy-label requirement. We are preparing the submission early to allow for this.

Decision needed: please approve the privacy-label wording by Wednesday so we can submit on time.

task.prompt: Before an AI drafts your status report, work out the progress figures yourself so you can check its numbers.

fields.label: Stories done as a share of planned
Points done as a share of planned

task.explanation: 20 / 25 = 80% of stories; 38 / 50 = 76% of points. If the AI draft says otherwise, correct it.

prompt: Who is responsible for the content of an AI-drafted status report?

options: The developers whose tickets it read
mcq.explanation: AI drafts; the PM verifies and owns what is sent.

prompt: Which instruction most reduces invented content in an AI status draft?

options: Use only the facts provided and list anything uncertain as an open question
mcq.explanation: Grounding the model in provided facts and allowing it to say what is unknown reduces fabrication.

prompt: Before pasting project data into an AI tool for a status report, what should you remove?

options: Personal data, credentials and anything the task does not need
mcq.explanation: Minimise what you share; secrets never belong in prompts.
